claim: Phase v21 tested whether the Dark Manifold v2.1 100-gene model (Nikku03/cell-simulation, dark_manifold_100gene.pt) could top up v15 (the highest-MCC essentiality predictor at 0.5372 against Breuer 2019 Syn3A) via late-fusion of the Dark Manifold's per-gene |atp_drop| signal with v15's binary calls. Four fusion rules were swept on the 36 overlapping JCVISYN3A locus tags (the genes in both the Dark Manifold's 102-gene set and Breuer's 455-gene labelled set): (A) v15-only baseline; (B) OR rule (predict essential if v15==1 OR |atp_drop| >= t); (C) DM override on overlap; (D) weighted-score fusion sweeping alpha and threshold. ALL FOUR rules return MCC=0.5372 — delta = 0.0000 vs the v15 baseline. Top-up does NOT improve MCC. The reason is structural: all 36 overlap genes are labelled essential by Breuer AND already correctly called essential by v15 (TP). The Dark Manifold's gene set is a strict subset of v15's existing TP set, so fusion can only confirm v15's correct calls or override them into incorrect calls — it cannot recover any of v15's 96 false negatives, which are concentrated in gene categories (uncharacterized, transport, regulatory) that the Dark Manifold's curated central-metabolism + tRNA + ribosomal-core gene set does not cover. v21 = MEASURED null (no improvement) with a clear structural explanation.
source_detail: Reproducible via scripts/v15_dm_fusion.py. Output: outputs/v15_dm_fusion.json + outputs/v15_dm_fusion_overlap_detail.csv. Inputs: outputs/predictions_parallel_s0.05_t0.5_seed42_thr0.1_w4_composed_all455_v15_round2_priors.csv (v15 predictions, 455 rows); Nikku03/cell-simulation dark_manifold_100gene.pt (Dark Manifold v2.1 checkpoint). KO sweep is 102 genes x 100 rollout steps on CPU, reproducible deterministically.
caveats: Structural ceiling: Dark Manifold's 102-gene set was curated around central metabolism + tRNA synthetases + ribosomal core + ATP synthase + transcription core. v15 already calls every one of those classes essential with high confidence (its 96 false negatives are concentrated elsewhere — uncharacterized genes, transport, regulatory). Late-fusion can only act on the overlap, and the overlap is exactly the region where v15 is already perfect. The result is robust across all four fusion rules tried; it is NOT a tuning artefact.

v15's 96 false negatives are the gain headroom. To bump MCC above 0.5372, an ML signal would need coverage of those 96 specific locus tags — none of which are in the Dark Manifold's gene list. Future top-up attempts should screen for gene-set overlap with v15's FN before running the fusion sweep.

The fusion sweep is post-hoc threshold-tuned on the same data being scored (no held-out split). Even with that liberty, MCC does not exceed 0.5372 — strengthening the negative result. A held-out split would only confirm the same conclusion since none of the rules pull above baseline even on the training fold.

This negative result complements v20 (UNDETERMINED) and v20b (at-chance ranking on single-class subsets): all three v20+ phases reflect the same root cause — the Dark Manifold's gene-set bias toward known essentials means it has no information to add about the genes that v15 currently misclassifies.

Confidence: measured (the experiment is real, reproducible, and the result is supported by an exhaustive 4-rule sweep over the overlap). The claim is strictly that top-up does not improve MCC for THIS specific Dark Manifold checkpoint on THIS specific gene overlap; it does not generalize to any future ML model with broader gene-set coverage.
